Subsidy: 50-100% subsidy under MGNREGA, PM Krishi Sinchai Yojana, State schemes. Apply through Gram Panchayat or Agriculture office!
Groundwater recharge: Percolation pits, recharge wells, contour bunds, check dams. Let rainwater soak into ground. Raises water table. Benefits wells/borewells!
Calculate storage: 1 acre catchment with 500mm rainfall can collect 2 million liters! Even storing 10-20% meets significant irrigation need. Worth the investment!
Watershed: Area draining to common point. Manage entire watershed for water conservation, erosion control, productivity improvement. Community approach!
In-field practices: Contour cultivation, field bunds, graded bunds, contour trenches, land leveling. Reduce runoff, increase infiltration, prevent erosion!
Drainage line treatment: Gully plugs, check dams, gabion structures, farm ponds. Slow water flow, allow percolation, reduce erosion, store water!
Biological measures: Afforestation, grass strips, vegetative bunds, agroforestry. Living barriers, soil binding roots, long-term solution!
Government programs: PMKSY (watershed component), MGNREGA, State watershed programs. Apply through District Watershed Office. Free works in farmers' fields!
Erosion types: Sheet erosion (top layer removed uniformly), Rill erosion (small channels), Gully erosion (deep channels). All remove fertile topsoil!
Causes: Bare soil + heavy rain + slope. Deforestation, overgrazing, poor farming practices. 5 billion tonnes soil lost annually in India!
Vegetative measures: Maintain soil cover (crops, mulch), grass strips on contours, cover crops, agroforestry, hedge rows. Living roots hold soil!
Engineering measures: Contour bunds, graded bunds, bench terracing (hills), check dams, gabion structures. Physical barriers to water flow!
Good practices: Avoid leaving soil bare, no burning crop residue, minimize tillage, maintain organic matter, grow cover crops between seasons!
Agroforestry: Integrating trees with crops/livestock on same land. Multiple benefits - timber, fruit, fodder, fuel + annual crop income + environmental services!
Agri-silviculture: Trees + crops. Poplar/Eucalyptus on boundary + wheat/potato in field. Mango/Citrus + vegetables intercrop. Trees provide long-term income!
Silvi-pasture: Trees + grass/fodder + livestock. Subabul/Leucaena with grass understory. Goats/cattle graze. Tree loppings as fodder. Triple benefit!
Popular trees: Poplar (6-7 years, timber), Eucalyptus (7-8 years, timber, oil), Teak (15-20 years, high value), Melia (8-10 years, plywood), Bamboo (3-4 years cutting)!
Government support: Sub-Mission on Agroforestry. Seedling subsidy. Assured buy-back for some species. Contact State Forest Development Corporation or Agriculture office!
Observed changes: Erratic monsoon (delayed, uneven distribution), more extreme events (floods, droughts), rising temperatures, new pests/diseases. Adapt or suffer!
Crop adaptation: Climate-resilient varieties (flood-tolerant Swarna Sub1, drought-tolerant maize), shift sowing dates, change crops if needed, short-duration varieties!
Water adaptation: Rainwater harvesting (every drop counts), efficient irrigation (drip/sprinkler), mulching (reduce evaporation), drought contingency crops!
Risk management: Crop insurance (PMFBY), diversification (don't depend on one crop), weather advisory (Agromet services), contingency planning (alternative crops ready)!
Carbon farming: Practices that store carbon - no-till, cover crops, agroforestry, biochar. Improve soil, reduce emissions, potential carbon credit income future!
Problem diagnosis checklist: 1) Check watering (too much/little?), 2) Soil condition (compacted/poor?), 3) Nutrient deficiency (leaf symptoms?), 4) Pests/diseases (visible signs?), 5) Weather stress?
Yellow leaves: Nitrogen deficiency (older leaves first), Iron/Zinc deficiency (young leaves), Overwatering, Root damage, Disease. Identify pattern to diagnose!
Wilting plants: Underwatering, Root rot (overwatering), Bacterial/Fungal wilt, Heat stress, Root damage. Check soil moisture and root health!
Stunted growth: Nutrient deficiency, Root problems, Nematodes, Compacted soil, Wrong variety, Cold temperatures. Soil test and root examination help!
